== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''wei''' is based on his given name (Yang-Wei).
* Infamously took [[Ignite (Summoner Spell)|Ignite]] instead of [[Smite (Summoner Spell)|Smite]] in game 1 of a match versus [[Bilibili Gaming]] in the [[LPL/2020 Season/Summer Season|LPL 2020 Summer Season]], and was fined by [[EStar (Chinese Team)|EStar]] for it. 
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 13, 2023.
** The 41st player and 7th jungler (after [[Clearlove]], [[SofM]], [[Karsa]], [[Tian]], [[Kanavi]], and [[Ning]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on August 22, 2025.
** The 32nd player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on August 05, 2024.
** Was the 33rd player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on July 29, 2025.
** The 35h player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on September 07, 2025.
** Was the 28th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}

=== Individual Awards ===
* MSI Finals MVP x1 (2022)
* LPL 1st All Pro Team x1 (Spring 2021)
* LPL 2nd All Pro Team x1 (Summer 2021) 
* LPL 3rd All Pro Team x2 (Summer 2022, Split 3 2025)
